reviews.body: ## Pull request overview This PR adds a professional startup experience for AffineDrift with a branded splash screen, loading animations, and performance tracking to improve perceived performance and provide a polished first impression. **Changes:** - Implements a custom splash screen with animated logo, progress bar, and status updates - Adds comprehensive performance metrics tracking (First Paint, FCP, Time to Interactive) - Includes skeleton loading framework and page reveal animations with reduced motion support ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | service-worker.js | Updated cache version and added startup launcher assets to precache | | js/startup-launcher.js | New startup launcher implementation with splash screen, progress tracking, and performance metrics | | css/startup-launcher.css | New stylesheet with splash screen styling, animations, and accessibility support | | _quarto.yml | Added preload hints and script inclusion for startup launcher assets | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
